briefing: Markets turned risk-off today with the NASDAQ down 1.4% and the S&P 500 down 0.9%, so no new candidates were screened. We're holding all 7 existing positions unchanged and keeping cash on the sidelines rather than forcing a buy into a weak tape.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets like growth stocks and tech shares, often rotating into safer holdings or cash. On these days, the smart move is usually to avoid chasing new positions and instead let your existing stop-loss and profit-target rules do the work automatically.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」(Risk-Off)是指投資者普遍賣出風險較高的資產,例如成長股和科技股,資金轉向較安全的資產或現金。在這類日子裡,較穩健的做法通常是避免追高買入新倉位,讓既有的停損和獲利目標機制自動發揮作用。

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based selling hit tech-heavy indices harder than the broader market, with the NASDAQ's 1.4% decline outpacing the S&P 500's 0.9% drop, suggesting growth and high-multiple names were the main source of weakness. No specific company or macro headlines were available in today's feed to pin down a single catalyst. Days like this are common pullbacks within a longer uptrend rather than signs of a structural shift.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大型指數普遍下跌,納斯達克指數下跌1.4%,跌幅大於標普500指數的0.9%,顯示科技股及高估值成長股是主要拖累來源。今日新聞資料中未提供具體的公司或宏觀消息可作為明確催化劑。這類回調在長期上升趨勢中屬常見現象,並非結構性轉變的訊號。
